integrity: The closed formulas are justified by an explicit general proof; the standalone finite checker corroborates but does not independently certify the unrestricted statements. Earlier even-cycle two-colour existence is not claimed as novel.
limitations: Equal independent layers, complete one-step forward arcs, finite d>=3 and m>=1; no assertion for unequal layers, extra arcs, weighted rules or uniqueness of fractional solutions. Possible unindexed equivalent literature.
title: Majority-stable-set polynomial and colouring phases for directed cycle blow-ups
